_description: Honeycomb for LLMs event → AKSI control mapping. Honeycomb ingests OpenTelemetry GenAI spans and adds derivative computed fields (cost-per-tenant, latency-p95, error-rate) and trigger annotations (alerts, SLO burn, BubbleUp anomaly detection). The importer maps native gen_ai.* operation values, status_code/error fields, Honeycomb trigger annotations, and derivative-field threshold breaches to AKSI controls.

notes: honeycomb.trigger.type=alert + severity=critical → DE-01 FAIL (Honeycomb already escalated; treat as confirmed incident)
honeycomb.trigger.type=slo_burn + severity=critical → PR-05 FAIL (SLO burn = production trust degradation; audit-trail integrity compromised)
honeycomb.trigger.type=anomaly_detection → PR-05 FLAG (BubbleUp surfaced anomaly — surface for human review)
honeycomb.derivative.error_rate_24h > 0.05 → PR-03 FLAG (recent prompt/tenant error degradation)
honeycomb.derivative.latency_p95_ms_24h > 30000ms → PR-03 FLAG (latency degradation = quality-of-service issue)
prompt.template_id present without prompt.version → PR-05 FLAG (un-versioned prompt = unauditable)
agent.framework absent on a gen_ai span → PR-05 FLAG (raw API use without framework attribution = audit-completeness gap)
